name: Knight of Cups
body:
Intuitive and soothing, you can read and manipulate emotions like a master tactician, seeking to avoid violence through dialogue whenever possible.

Prerequisite(s): Challenge class feature; Good alignment; Cha 13

Benefit: You may expend two uses of your Challenge ability to calm emotions, as per the spell, using one-half your cavalier level (rounding up) as your caster level. DC to resist is 10 + cha bonus + ½ cavalier level. This is an extraordinary ability.

Special: You may only possess 1 Knightly feat.
